pages.text: Put a $(item)Wagon Loader$() beside the track (two blocks away is best: its chute reaches over) with chests, barrels or other storage next to it. It works on every freight, tank and livestock wagon of a train standing beside it:$(li)$(l)Loading$() (green arrow): fills them from its storage, tanks and the animals round it$(li)$(l)Unloading$() (orange): empties them

Sneak-click it to switch between the two. It moves ten stacks a second; two at one train work twice as fast.$(br2)Redstone pauses it, a comparator reads how full the wagons are, and loading, it tops up tenders' coal and diesels' fuel too.$(br2)A timetabled train waits at a station until its loaders are done.
